findings.current: then roared and flung their weapons with all their strength.
findings.defect: “Flung their weapons” says the attackers let go of them; the source describes unleashing attacks with the weapons in their hands.
findings.rationale: 손에 쥔 keeps the weapons in their grasp during the attack.
findings.replacement: then roared and lashed out with the weapons in their hands, putting all their strength behind each blow.
findings.source: 온 힘을 다해 손에 쥔 병장기를 흩뿌리면서.

findings.current: Now the sensation of No-self was more intense than ever, taking over my entire body.
findings.defect: Uses the established term for 무아 rather than the distinct glossary term for 무아지경.
findings.rationale: The binding glossary distinguishes 무아지경 (“Trance”) from 무아 (“No-self”).
findings.replacement: Now the sensation of Trance was more intense than ever, taking over my entire body.
findings.source: 그 어느 때보다 강렬한 무아지경의 감각이 전신을 지배하고 있었다.

findings.current: Jin Taekyung struggled to sit up.
findings.defect: Changes getting to his feet into sitting up.
findings.rationale: 몸을 일으켜 세웠다 describes bringing his body upright, not merely sitting.
findings.replacement: Jin Taekyung struggled to his feet.

findings.current: Maybe it was because he’d suddenly woken from a state of No-self, when every sense had been pushed to its limit.
findings.defect: Again substitutes the term for 무아 for the source’s 무아지경.
findings.rationale: The binding glossary renders 무아지경 as “Trance.”
findings.replacement: Maybe it was because he’d suddenly woken from a Trance in which every sense had been pushed to its limit.
findings.source: 모든 감각이 최고조에 다다라있던 무아지경의 상태에서 돌연 깨어나서일까.

findings.current: More precisely, toward his beloved weapon, still lodged in their backs.
findings.defect: Places the weapon inside the charging enemies’ backs, contradicting the next sentence’s spear buried in the ground.
findings.rationale: 그들의 등 뒤에 locates the weapon behind the enemies; it does not say it is lodged in their bodies.
findings.replacement: More precisely, toward his beloved weapon, which lay behind them.
findings.source: 정확히는, 그들의 등 뒤에 남아 있는 자신의 애병을 향해.

findings.current: That damned cheerful voice was nowhere to be heard.
findings.rationale: 천진난만한 characterizes his guileless, childlike manner, not his mood.
findings.replacement: That damned innocent voice was nowhere to be heard.
findings.source: 그 빌어먹게도 천진난만한 목소리는 어디에서도 들을 수 없었다.

summary: Three action and positioning errors, plus characterization and terminology defects.
